added: PointLight.radius and SpotLight.radius set a spherical source size in metres. Near-source illumination uses distance² + radius², and specular highlights use Karis's energy-normalized representative point. The default zero preserves punctual lights; shadow softness is unchanged.

breaking.change: The reflected records add radius, default 0.
breaking.fix: Re-cook scenes against the updated schema; leave radius zero to preserve punctual lights.
